description: Run rls-policies and supabase-auth-config against the user's own Supabase project using credentials already in this server's environment: SUPABASE_URL plus SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY (or SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY), or SUPABASE_MGMT_TOKEN plus SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF. rls-policies lists tables in the public schema with row level security off or with permissive policies; supabase-auth-config reads the auth settings (open signup, email confirmation, OTP expiry). Each value is trimmed, sent only to that Supabase project, and never appears in the output. The service key is sent only to an https URL on a Supabase-hosted domain (the project URL Supabase issued); any other SUPABASE_URL skips the check unless SECUREALY_SUPABASE_HOST_OVERRIDE=1 is set for a self-hosted project. If a variable is missing the check is skipped with a reason; tell the user which variable to export, never ask them to paste it into the chat.
name: check_rls
title: Check Supabase RLS and auth config
